svg.text: SUPPLY 120 V 1-ph 60 Hz, cord and plug, 15/20 A receptacle on the bench (≈ 1.4 A full load)
L black / N white / PE green
J1 = 115 V line, J2 = 130 V armature (confirm in the manual)
plug-in HP resistor for 1/8 HP 130 V
I1 / I2 inhibit: closed = motor stopped
trimpots MIN / MAX / IR / CL / ACC (see settings)
1/8 HP 130 V DC 1.1 A, 190 rpm, 4.4 N·m; frame to PE (W1 green)
B1 NO 13-14 (closed with the carriage UP)
roller struck by the carriage plate top
PE: cord green → TB1 PE → PE stud on the back plate → lid bond strap, M1 frame (W1), base via the bench bolts. Check < 0.1 Ω PE stud to the column (ITP).
S1 ON powers A1 (H1 lit). With the carriage UP, B1 NO is closed on I1-I2 so A1 is inhibited: the chuck does not turn while the operator loads the container.
Pulling the lever lowers the carriage; B1 opens after ≈ 5 mm and A1 ramps the motor up (ACC ≈ 0.3 s) before the chuck reaches the cap (≈ 0.4 s at hand speed).
The slip clutch limits the cap torque; the motor runs on while the clutch slips until the operator releases the lever; the gas spring lifts the carriage and B1 inhibits A1 at the top.
E-stop S0 opens the AC line to A1 (two NC contacts in series, stop category 0); the motor coasts to rest in < 1 s (low inertia, clutch). Twist to release, then the lever returns the cycle.
The lever is hold-to-run by nature: releasing it lifts the chuck away from the hands. The polycarbonate guard P1-412-303 surrounds the chuck at all heights.

the clutch, not CL, limits cap torque; CL protects the motor
smooth start before the chuck lands on the cap
trim for steady speed while the clutch slips
1. Load: motor 1.1 A DC → ≈ 1.4 A AC (SCR form factor); F1 3 A time-delay protects the cord (14 AWG) and the drive; the bench circuit is 15/20 A.
2. Inhibit and pot leads are low-level signals: shielded, kept apart from the AC and armature wires; shield to A1 COM at the drive end only.
3. E-stop removes AC from A1 (two NC contacts). If a later risk assessment asks for a monitored stop, add a safety relay and contactor ahead of A1 (space on the rail).
4. B1 fails safe for the hands only with the guard: a broken I1-I2 wire lets the motor run with the carriage up, so the guard P1-412-303 is required (ITP checks both).
5. All lid devices bonded to PE via the lid strap; cord grip at the gland, 150 mm service loop for W1 at the carriage.
